summary: Streaming disconnects on chat completions correlated with packet loss in us-west (SSE clients see dropped streams / ECONNRESET)
description:
Customer report
- Company: ArborPay (enterprise)
- Reported via: Support portal + attached client logs
- What they see: intermittent streaming disconnects while calling Chat Completions with stream=true (SSE). Non-streaming requests succeed more often.

Impact
- User-visible: partial responses (stream drops mid-generation) requiring client retry.
- ArborPay estimates: ~1.8–3.5% of streaming requests failed over ~40 minutes.
- Severity drivers: customer uses streaming for end-user UX; retries increase latency and cost.

Time window (customer)
- 2025-04-18 16:05–16:50 UTC (intermittent)

Environment / routing
- prod, us-west endpoint (customer indicated default region routing; they are pinned to us-west for latency)
- Protocol: HTTPS, SSE (text/event-stream)

Customer evidence (excerpts)
1) Client-side errors
- 2025-04-18T16:17:03.291Z stream error: Error: read ECONNRESET
- 2025-04-18T16:17:03.292Z request_id=rp_01HVQZ7K2FQY7M9F1K6PZC0N9X attempt=1 bytes_received=18422
- 2025-04-18T16:22:41.992Z stream error: Error: socket hang up

2) Customer curl repro (sanitized)
- POST https://api.us-west.redwoodinference.com/v1/chat/completions
- stream: true
- payload: ~2.8k prompt tokens, max_output_tokens=1024
- disconnect happens variably at ~100–700 output tokens

Redwood initial investigation
- Correlated with elevated packet loss / retransmits on a subset of paths into us-west edge POP.
- API gateway shows connection termination mid-stream, consistent with client connection dropped (not model/runtime crash).

Relevant internal signals (us-west)
- Edge/network:
  - edge.tcp_retransmits_rate spiked to 2.1–3.8% (baseline <0.3%) during 16:10–16:45 UTC
  - synthetic-probe.packet_loss (external probes) peaked ~1.5–2.0% to us-west edge VIP
- API gateway:
  - sse_stream_disconnects_total increased (reason=client_connection_lost)
  - http_499_rate elevated for streaming routes
- Serving runtime:
  - No corresponding spike in model errors; gpu utilization normal; no OOMs detected.

Gateway log excerpts (sanitized)
- 2025-04-18T16:17:03.289Z level=warn service=api-gateway region=us-west route=/v1/chat/completions msg="stream terminated" request_id=gw_01HVQZ7K2FG7D8F3P1A2P9HZ9X status=499 duration_ms=42183 bytes_sent=18422 model=redwood/llama-3.1-70b-instruct disconnect_reason=client_connection_lost
- 2025-04-18T16:22:41.990Z level=warn service=api-gateway region=us-west route=/v1/chat/completions msg="upstream write aborted" request_id=gw_01HVQZ8J9N0RJY5KBP2JDT5B3A status=499 duration_ms=31602 bytes_sent=10211 model=redwood/qwen2.5-72b-instruct disconnect_reason=client_connection_lost

Hypothesis
- Root cause is network impairment (packet loss) causing long-lived streaming connections to reset; shorter non-streaming requests less likely to be impacted.

Mitigation / workaround communicated to customer
- If acceptable, temporarily route streaming traffic to us-east for the impacted window (or implement regional fallback client-side).
- Increase client resilience:
  - retry on disconnect with idempotency key and resume strategy (if application supports replay)
  - exponential backoff + jitter; cap concurrent retries
  - set read timeout slightly above expected generation time; avoid aggressive idle timeouts during SSE

Internal follow-ups / preventative work
- Add packet-loss and network-path health into standardized region health signals so regional degradation is detected earlier.
- Tie these signals into the Regional failover automation upgrade (trigger engine + safe-to-failover checks) to shift traffic away from degraded regions faster and reduce reliance on manual intervention.

Current status
- Network impairment cleared by ~16:50 UTC.
- Monitoring shows metrics returned to baseline; no continued customer reports after mitigation guidance.

Requested from customer
- Confirm whether they can (a) implement client-side regional fallback for streaming and/or (b) allow temporary dynamic routing during impairments.
- Share any additional request IDs around 16:10–16:45 UTC if they see recurrence.
comments: 2025-04-18 16:58 UTC - Owen Phillips (Support): Acknowledged receipt to ArborPay, requested sample request_ids + confirmation whether they are pinned to us-west endpoint vs global. Flagged as P1 due to user-visible streaming failures.

2025-04-18 17:07 UTC - Dev Patel (Support escalation): Looping in #incidents and Networking. Noting prior similar symptoms in SUP-19240 (elevated 5xx) but this looks like mid-stream disconnects/499s rather than 5xx from runtime.

2025-04-18 17:21 UTC - Emily Zhao (Cross-region connectivity): Seeing elevated retransmits and mild packet loss on us-west edge VIP from multiple probe sources starting ~16:10 UTC. No evidence of internal packet drops between gateway and runtime. Likely upstream/ISP path impairment into POP. Tracking under INC-2025-0418-USW-PACKETLOSS. Recommend advising customer to switch endpoint/region temporarily if possible.

2025-04-18 17:35 UTC - Victor Alvarez (Network routing/DNS): Confirmed edge side shows increased TCP resets on a subset of ingress interfaces. Engaging provider and draining one affected edge pool. Expect improvement within 15–30 minutes if path shifts.

2025-04-18 17:44 UTC - Owen Phillips (Support): Sent ArborPay interim update: we’re observing network impairment into us-west impacting long-lived streaming connections; suggested temporary us-east routing for stream=true calls and retries on ECONNRESET/socket hang up. Asked if they can switch for the next hour as mitigation.
2025-04-18 18:19 UTC - Emily Zhao: Metrics improving. retransmits_rate down to ~0.6% and falling; synthetic loss trending <0.5%. Continuing to monitor for another 60 minutes.

2025-04-18 19:06 UTC - Owen Phillips (Support): ArborPay confirmed they switched streaming traffic to us-east and error rate dropped to near-zero immediately. They will keep non-latency-sensitive streaming in us-east until we confirm stability in us-west.

2025-04-19 09:12 UTC - Allison Grant (Observability): Added temporary panel note to internal failover dashboard draft: include sse_stream_disconnects_total + packet_loss as first-class health signals; current alerting is 5xx-centric and misses this failure mode.

2025-04-19 12:48 UTC - Tomáš Novák (SRE): Follow-up: this is a good example for the Regional failover automation upgrade—network-path health should contribute to degraded state and trigger progressive failover (starting with streaming routes / lower tiers). Linking Confluence program overview and region health signals standard for incorporation.

2025-04-20 15:30 UTC - Owen Phillips (Support): Sent close-out to ArborPay: impairment resolved; recommended keeping regional fallback for streaming; offered a brief technical review of our upcoming automated regional degradation/failover improvements and how they will reduce recurrence/MTTR.
resolution: Resolved after us-west ingress path impairment cleared and an affected edge pool was drained. Customer mitigated by routing streaming traffic to us-east during the window. Follow-up item captured: incorporate packet-loss + SSE disconnect rate into standardized region health signals and automated failover/degraded-routing policies (see linked Confluence pages).
